source.extraction: js-beautify + regex extraction of the HID->label table
source.note: Labels are UI strings only. The wire format carries the raw HID usage id in event.code with event.page selecting the HID usage page (1 = keyboard/button, 12 = consumer/media).

evdev_mapping_provenance: derived: standard USB HID keyboard usage -> Linux input-event-codes mapping (hid-input.c).
